product.name: HyperPay Payments
product.description: An online payment gateway that enables businesses to accept local and international payments through integrated card, wallet, prepaid, and regional payment methods.

product.name: HyperBill
product.description: A billing solution for creating and managing payment requests, invoices, and recurring or subscription-based customer payments.

product.name: HyperSplit
product.description: A payout and payment-splitting solution that helps businesses distribute funds and manage customized payouts to multiple recipients.

product.name: HyperPay Protect
product.description: A payment protection and risk-management service that detects suspicious transactions and helps reduce fraud and chargeback-related losses.

product.name: HyperSight
product.description: A payment analytics and reporting tool that provides dashboards, transaction monitoring, visualizations, and reports for operational and business analysis.

product.name: HyperTap
product.description: A software-based point-of-sale solution that turns compatible NFC-enabled Android devices into terminals for EMV contactless payments.
